messages:
nina: Heads-up: after we turned on strict project-binding in router-prod, a small but steady class of requests started 403ing. Logs show missing project_claim for some API keys.

omar: Can you share a snippet? Is this limited to service-account tokens or regular API keys?

nina: Snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T18:22:11Z] req=7f1 auth=API_KEY key=ak_old_77 route=project-bind result=DENIED reason="missing_project_claim"
[2026-03-19T18:22:11Z] req=7f2 auth=API_KEY key=ak_old_77 fallback=org-default route=billing result=200
```

ben.j: Looks like tokens minted pre-schema-v2 don't have project claim. We planned migration but skipped a final sweep. If we flip enforcement it breaks old clients.

omar: UX/metrics issue: console shows quota usage against org pool but no indication many requests were fallbacks. Customers get surprised.

julia.pm: Product note: we need conservative handling: keep strict binding as opt-in, default to soft-fallback. But surface that in Console and billing dashboards.

nina: Proposal: router config: default_on_missing = soft_fallback; annotate with header `X-Effective-Project: project:<id> | billing:<org>`; emit metric `auth.resolve=project|billing_fallback|denied`.

omar: Also add labels for `key_prefix` and `token_schema` on the `auth.resolve` counter so we can identify issuers. Add a sampled log line with req id for each fallback event.

ben.j: Telemetry: add dimension `effective_project` to request traces and `auth_resolution` (values: project, billing_fallback, denied). Console: add a Request Logs column and a per-tenant summary card showing fallback_pct.

julia.pm: Alerting: if fallback_pct > 0.5% over 5m for any org, create a ticket assigned to the CSM. Also add an in-Console banner when a tenant sees >1% fallback for 15m.

nina: Canary plan: roll router soft-fallback to 1% traffic for 30min, collect `auth.resolve` and `auth.resolve/by_key_prefix`. If any key_prefix >2% fallback, trigger outreach flow. Rollback if total fallback >5% in first hour.

omar: Implementation notes: sticky routing TTL 25s to avoid churn, and ensure KV cache keys include effective_project header. Update unit tests for schema-less tokens.

ben.j: I'll open ENG-1401 (router: soft-fallback + metrics) and ENG-1402 (telemetry dims + Console UI). Nina/Omar pair to review PRs.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: router-soft-fallback/canary -> 1% at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z :rocket:

julia.pm: Approved for canary. Please include a short customer-facing doc snippet describing why org billing may appear and how to rotate tokens.

nina: Will do. Also adding logs scrub to avoid leaking token material.

julia.pm: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here and ping me if alerts fire. :thumbsup:
